artists_lifecycle_check.name: artists_lifecycle_check
artists_lifecycle_check.value:
(
    ("artists"."lifecycle_status" in ('draft', 'in_review') and "artists"."scheduled_for" is null and "artists"."published_at" is null and "artists"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("artists"."lifecycle_status" = 'scheduled' and "artists"."scheduled_for" is not null and "artists"."published_at" is null and "artists"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("artists"."lifecycle_status" = 'published' and "artists"."published_at" is not null and "artists"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("artists"."lifecycle_status" = 'archived' and "artists"."archived_at" is not null)
  )

artists_publication_order_check.name: artists_publication_order_check
artists_publication_order_check.value: "artists"."published_at" is null or "artists"."scheduled_for" is null or "artists"."published_at" >= "artists"."scheduled_for"

artwork_assets_dimensions_check.name: artwork_assets_dimensions_check
artwork_assets_dimensions_check.value: ("artwork_assets"."width" is null and "artwork_assets"."height" is null) or ("artwork_assets"."width" is not null and "artwork_assets"."height" is not null and "artwork_assets"."width" > 0 and "artwork_assets"."height" > 0)

releases_lifecycle_check.name: releases_lifecycle_check
releases_lifecycle_check.value:
(
    ("releases"."lifecycle_status" in ('draft', 'in_review') and "releases"."scheduled_for" is null and "releases"."published_at" is null and "releases"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("releases"."lifecycle_status" = 'scheduled' and "releases"."scheduled_for" is not null and "releases"."published_at" is null and "releases"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("releases"."lifecycle_status" = 'published' and "releases"."published_at" is not null and "releases"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("releases"."lifecycle_status" = 'archived' and "releases"."archived_at" is not null)
  )

releases_publication_order_check.name: releases_publication_order_check
releases_publication_order_check.value: "releases"."published_at" is null or "releases"."scheduled_for" is null or "releases"."published_at" >= "releases"."scheduled_for"

tracks_lifecycle_check.name: tracks_lifecycle_check
tracks_lifecycle_check.value:
(
    ("tracks"."lifecycle_status" in ('draft', 'in_review') and "tracks"."scheduled_for" is null and "tracks"."published_at" is null and "tracks"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("tracks"."lifecycle_status" = 'scheduled' and "tracks"."scheduled_for" is not null and "tracks"."published_at" is null and "tracks"."archived_at" is null)
    or ("tracks"."lifecycle_status" = 'published' and "tracks"."published_at" is not null and "tracks"."archived_at" is null)

  )

tracks_publication_order_check.name: tracks_publication_order_check
tracks_publication_order_check.value: "tracks"."published_at" is null or "tracks"."scheduled_for" is null or "tracks"."published_at" >= "tracks"."scheduled_for"

publication_audit_reason_check.name: publication_audit_reason_check
publication_audit_reason_check.value: "publication_audit"."to_lifecycle" not in ('published', 'archived') or nullif(btrim("publication_audit"."reason"), '') is not null

upload_sessions_metadata_check.name: upload_sessions_metadata_check
upload_sessions_metadata_check.value:
(
        ("upload_sessions"."asset_kind" = 'artwork' and "upload_sessions"."target_entity_type" in ('artist', 'release', 'track', 'collection') and "upload_sessions"."width" > 0 and "upload_sessions"."height" > 0 and "upload_sessions"."duration_ms" is null and "upload_sessions"."codec" is null and "upload_sessions"."mime_type" ~ '^image/')
        or
        ("upload_sessions"."asset_kind" = 'audio' and "upload_sessions"."target_entity_type" = 'track' and "upload_sessions"."width" is null and "upload_sessions"."height" is null and "upload_sessions"."duration_ms" > 0 and nullif(btrim("upload_sessions"."codec"), '') is not null and "upload_sessions"."mime_type" ~ '^audio/')
      )

upload_sessions_state_check.name: upload_sessions_state_check
upload_sessions_state_check.value:
(
        ("upload_sessions"."status" = 'pending' and "upload_sessions"."completed_at" is null and "upload_sessions"."failure_reason" is null)
        or ("upload_sessions"."status" = 'completed' and "upload_sessions"."completed_at" is not null and "upload_sessions"."failure_reason" is null)
        or ("upload_sessions"."status" in ('abandoned', 'failed') and "upload_sessions"."completed_at" is null)
      )

editorial_collections_lifecycle_check.name: editorial_collections_lifecycle_check
editorial_collections_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("editorial_collections"."lifecycle_status" in ('draft', 'in_review') and "editorial_collections"."scheduled_for" is null and "editorial_collections"."published_at" is null and "editorial_collections"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("editorial_collections"."lifecycle_status" = 'scheduled' and "editorial_collections"."scheduled_for" is not null and "editorial_collections"."published_at" is null and "editorial_collections"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("editorial_collections"."lifecycle_status" = 'published' and "editorial_collections"."published_at" is not null and "editorial_collections"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("editorial_collections"."lifecycle_status" = 'archived' and "editorial_collections"."archived_at" is not null)
      )

editorial_collections_publication_order_.name: editorial_collections_publication_order_check
editorial_collections_publication_order_.value: "editorial_collections"."published_at" is null or "editorial_collections"."scheduled_for" is null or "editorial_collections"."published_at" >= "editorial_collections"."scheduled_for"

creative_process_disclosures_finalized_c.name: creative_process_disclosures_finalized_check
creative_process_disclosures_finalized_c.value: ("creative_process_disclosures"."status" = 'draft' and "creative_process_disclosures"."finalized_at" is null) or ("creative_process_disclosures"."status" in ('finalized', 'superseded') and "creative_process_disclosures"."finalized_at" is not null)

creative_process_disclosures_revision_au.name: creative_process_disclosures_revision_author_check
creative_process_disclosures_revision_au.value:
nullif(btrim("creative_process_disclosures"."revision_author_name"), '') is not null
        and position('@' in "creative_process_disclosures"."revision_author_email") > 1
        and nullif(btrim("creative_process_disclosures"."revision_reason"), '') is not null

provenance_evidence_object_key_check.name: provenance_evidence_object_key_check
provenance_evidence_object_key_check.value: "provenance_evidence"."object_key" !~* '^https?://' and "provenance_evidence"."object_key" like 'private/evidence/%' and nullif(btrim("provenance_evidence"."object_key"), '') is not null

provenance_records_finalized_check.name: provenance_records_finalized_check
provenance_records_finalized_check.value: ("provenance_records"."status" = 'draft' and "provenance_records"."finalized_at" is null) or ("provenance_records"."status" in ('finalized', 'superseded') and "provenance_records"."finalized_at" is not null)

provenance_records_revision_author_check.name: provenance_records_revision_author_check
provenance_records_revision_author_check.value:
nullif(btrim("provenance_records"."revision_author_name"), '') is not null
        and position('@' in "provenance_records"."revision_author_email") > 1
        and nullif(btrim("provenance_records"."revision_reason"), '') is not null

rights_declarations_attestation_check.name: rights_declarations_attestation_check
rights_declarations_attestation_check.value: ("rights_declarations"."status" = 'draft' and "rights_declarations"."attested_at" is null and "rights_declarations"."attestation" is null) or ("rights_declarations"."status" in ('attested', 'superseded') and "rights_declarations"."attested_at" is not null and nullif(btrim("rights_declarations"."attestation"), '') is not null)

rights_declarations_revision_author_chec.name: rights_declarations_revision_author_check
rights_declarations_revision_author_chec.value:
nullif(btrim("rights_declarations"."revision_author_name"), '') is not null
        and position('@' in "rights_declarations"."revision_author_email") > 1
        and nullif(btrim("rights_declarations"."revision_reason"), '') is not null

rights_declarations_entitlement_check.name: rights_declarations_entitlement_check
rights_declarations_entitlement_check.value:
nullif(btrim("rights_declarations"."entitlement_statement"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("rights_declarations"."public_summary"), '') is not null

evidence_upload_sessions_state_check.name: evidence_upload_sessions_state_check
evidence_upload_sessions_state_check.value:
(
        ("evidence_upload_sessions"."status" = 'pending' and "evidence_upload_sessions"."completed_at" is null and "evidence_upload_sessions"."failure_reason" is null)
        or ("evidence_upload_sessions"."status" = 'completed' and "evidence_upload_sessions"."completed_at" is not null and "evidence_upload_sessions"."failure_reason" is null)
        or ("evidence_upload_sessions"."status" in ('abandoned', 'failed') and "evidence_upload_sessions"."completed_at" is null)
      )

submission_activities_status_change_chec.name: submission_activities_status_change_check
submission_activities_status_change_chec.value:
"submission_activities"."activity_type" <> 'status_change'
        or ("submission_activities"."from_status" is not null and "submission_activities"."to_status" is not null)

submission_invitations_email_check.name: submission_invitations_email_check
submission_invitations_email_check.value: position('@' in "submission_invitations"."invitee_email") > 1 and nullif(btrim("submission_invitations"."invitee_email"), '') is not null

submissions_submitted_timestamp_check.name: submissions_submitted_timestamp_check
submissions_submitted_timestamp_check.value: ("submissions"."status" = 'draft' and "submissions"."submitted_at" is null) or ("submissions"."status" <> 'draft' and "submissions"."submitted_at" is not null)

submissions_reviewed_timestamp_check.name: submissions_reviewed_timestamp_check
submissions_reviewed_timestamp_check.value: "submissions"."status" not in ('eligibility_review', 'listening', 'clarification_requested', 'accepted', 'rejected') or "submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null

submissions_assignment_check.name: submissions_assignment_check
submissions_assignment_check.value:
("submissions"."assigned_curator_id" is null and "submissions"."assigned_curator_email" is null and "submissions"."assigned_at" is null)
        or ("submissions"."assigned_curator_id" is not null and "submissions"."assigned_curator_email" is not null and "submissions"."assigned_at" is not null)

submissions_acceptance_pins_check.name: submissions_acceptance_pins_check
submissions_acceptance_pins_check.value:
"submissions"."status" <> 'accepted' or (
        "submissions"."accepted_rights_declaration_id" is not null
        and "submissions"."accepted_creative_process_disclosure_id" is not null
        and "submissions"."accepted_provenance_record_id" is not null
      )
